observation.summary: Village raid elites spawn with 1.4x current health but retain the normal unit maxHealth, creating health > maxHealth at creation.

evidence.statement: Elite health multiplies budget.health by 1.4 while maxHealth is assigned budget.health unconditionally.

hypothesis.cause: Elite scaling is applied only to health, not to the matching maximum-health state.
hypothesis.prediction: Deriving one maxHealth value per actor and assigning both fields from it makes every raid actor spawn with health <= maxHealth while preserving elite durability.
hypothesis.falsifier: Any spawned actor still has health greater than maxHealth or elite health loses its authored 1.4x scaling.

candidates.reason: Keeps authored elite multiplier and removes contradictory state at creation.
Would silently erase elite durability instead of repairing the invariant.

implementation.summary: Use the same scaled maxHealth for elite current/max HP and assert the spawn invariant in an existing Simulation test.

before.summary: Every sixth raid actor can spawn at 140% of its recorded maxHealth.

limitations: Direct native spawn invariant only; no visual HUD/browser claim.

next: After merge, switch to kuumetsu and choose its first independent root cause.
